item: The kernel's kill counters are read at each session start and compared at the next
summary: oom_kill from /proc/vmstat (machine-wide) and the cgroup's memory.events/limit/peak (v2 and v1) are stored in the session sentinel; the previous-session report counts kills between two starts only within one boot and one cgroup, and names every unreadable counter with its reason instead of zero. Closes question 22 where no kernel log can be read.
